summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by ProQR Therapeutics N.V., a foreign private issuer, furnishing a press release of first quarter 2026 operating and financial results. The release provides business updates on pipeline programs (AX-0810, AX-0811, AX-0422), cash position of €81.1 million, and upcoming milestones. There is no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, or tender offer. The filing is a standard periodic earnings report with no corporate action triggering a special-situations classification.
